relations.subject: S. Kuppuswami Sastri
relations.evidence: As a child Kuppuswami Sastri studied Vedanta, Nyaya and Mimamsa from the Sanskrit scholar Brahmendra Sarasvati

relations.subject: S. Kuppuswami Sastri
relations.object: S. P. G. College in Thanjavur
relations.evidence: Kuppuswami Sastri completed his graduation from the S. P. G. College in Thanjavur in 1900

relations.subject: S. Kuppuswami Sastri
relations.evidence: and completed his M. A. in Sanskrit from the University of Madras in 1905.

relations.subject: S. Kuppuswami Sastri
relations.evidence: Kuppuswami Sastri was appointed Principal of the newly established Madras Sanskrit College in 1906. He headed Madras Sanskrit College till 1910

relations.subject: S. Kuppuswami Sastri
relations.evidence: he took over as Principal of the Rajah's College, Tiruvadi serving till 1914.

relations.subject: S. Kuppuswami Sastri
relations.role: Professor of Sanskrit and Classical Philology
relations.evidence: served as professor of Sanskrit and Classical Philology at the Presidency College, Madras and curator of the Government Oriental Manuscripts Library and Research Centre from 1914 to 1935.

relations.subject: S. Kuppuswami Sastri
relations.object: Government Oriental Manuscripts Library and Research Centre
relations.evidence: curator of the Government Oriental Manuscripts Library and Research Centre from 1914 to 1935.

relations.subject: S. Kuppuswami Sastri
relations.evidence: In 1927, Kuppuswami Sastri founded the Journal of Oriental Research

relations.subject: S. Kuppuswami Sastri
relations.evidence: He also founded the Samskrta Academy to promote research in Sanskrit.

relations.subject: S. Kuppuswami Sastri
relations.evidence: was appointed Honorary Professor of Sanskrit at the Annamalai University in Chidambaram.
